sources.title: BERT Models for Brazilian Portuguese NLP
sources.snippet: This paper presents the development and evaluation of BERT models specifically for Brazilian Portuguese, referred to as BERTimbau. The models demonstrate improved performance on three natural language processing tasks: sentence textual similarity, recognizing textual entailment, and named entity recognition, surpassing the capabilities of Multilingual BERT.
